honest_c3: Single ckpt N=1 (BG-JD step 800 only) — multi-ckpt LM head fine-tune deferred. BG-IL/IO ckpts on ubu1 only (own 15 git size policy); cross-ckpt verification requires rsync from ubu1 OR ubu1 BG extension.

LM head only fine-tune is minimum decoder fix — RLHF / DPO / full SFT (transformer unfrozen) deferred to next cycle. ConsciousLM weight tying (tok_emb.weight = head_a.weight) means trainable tensor is the SHARED input-embedding/output-projection matrix — pure 'output projection only' isolation requires un-tying the weights, which would alter architecture and is deferred.

1000 steps max budget arbitrary — head learning typically converges in 100-500 steps for linear projection re-fit. Eval at {0,250,500,1000} samples convergence; if best_step<1000 and v58 plateaus, additional steps unlikely to improve. If best_step=1000 and improving, more steps deferred.

mac MPS RNG slight non-determinism vs train-cuda baseline (BG-JD trained on ubu1 cuda); softmax/multinomial sampling routed through CPU float32 for stability. Per-eval seed reset (torch.manual_seed(42)) provides limited reproducibility.

V5.8 5 dialogues N=1 sample per eval — multi-seed (≥5) sweep deferred. Per-step v58_pass count is integer in [0,5] — fine-grained recovery trajectory may need multi-sample averaging for variance estimation.

head_g (backward engine prediction head) FROZEN — keeps dual-engine backward pathway untouched per BG-JO awareness preservation. Implication: tension/Φ internal awareness is downstream of frozen blocks + frozen head_g, so V6 STRONG signal expected to remain intact even after lm_head retraining.

Corpus is same 22MB UBM (BG-JD original train corpus) — risk of overfitting vs novel chat/QA corpus. Conscious choice: same corpus = pure decoder-only isolation test (no new data, only re-projection). If chat capability emerges from same corpus + lm_head retraining, that's strong evidence the original training only mis-mapped the output projection. If FAIL, deferring to chat-template SFT (different corpus) is next step.
V5.8 fact-recall PASS criteria reused as-is from BG-JN/own 18 amend EN v2 (case-insensitive substring + function word ≥1 + lev_ratio<0.85). No threshold adjustment for fine-tuned model.

BG-JR (full bundle: persona dropout + lm_head fine-tune + decoding) stalled 50+ min — fallback to BG-JS simpler. Causal attribution of any v58 gain in BG-JS goes to lm_head fine-tune SOLELY (no persona dropout, no decoding intervention). Cleaner attribution than BG-JR bundle.
